setup: Reset SQLite; login as admin@eshop.com; set adminToken and categoryId=1; generate productRunSuffix
test_action: POST /api/products with the admin bearer token and name_prefix-productRunSuffix

teardown: DELETE /api/products/:createdProductId with the admin token and verify the id is no longer retrievable
